lines.text: الأُولَى ونرسُم على تقاطُع الدائرتَيْن علامتَيْ {ov:ف} {ov:ق} ونُخْرِج ايضًا خطّ {ov:ه ز} ونُنْفِذه الى علامة {ov:ع} من
lines.plain: الأُولَى ونرسُم على تقاطُع الدائرتَيْن علامتَيْ ف ق ونُخْرِج ايضًا خطّ ه ز ونُنْفِذه الى علامة ع من

lines.text: الدائرة الأُولَى فعلامة {ov:ع} تقَع على نِصْف قَوْس {ov:ف ق} ونرسُم على محيط الدائرة التي للقمر حيْثُ يقطَعها
lines.plain: الدائرة الأُولَى فعلامة ع تقَع على نِصْف قَوْس ف ق ونرسُم على محيط الدائرة التي للقمر حيْثُ يقطَعها

lines.text: خطّ {ov:ز ه ع} علامة {ov:ح} فخطّ {ov:ع ح} وَسَط تَقْوِيس الهِلال ومَوْضِع وَسَط الضَّوْء وهو مقدار ما في القمر
lines.plain: خطّ ز ه ع علامة ح فخطّ ع ح وَسَط تَقْوِيس الهِلال ومَوْضِع وَسَط الضَّوْء وهو مقدار ما في القمر

lines.text: من اصابع الضوْء وعلامتَيْ {ov:ف} {ov:ق} هما طَرَفَيِ الهِلَال ومَيْلهما على خطّ الاعتدال القائم على فلك البروج
lines.plain: من اصابع الضوْء وعلامتَيْ ف ق هما طَرَفَيِ الهِلَال ومَيْلهما على خطّ الاعتدال القائم على فلك البروج

lines.text: *معلوم بقوْس {ov:ا ف} وقوْس {ov:ج ق} وذلك أنّ نُقْطة {ov:ا} حينَئِذٍ تكون على سَمْت الجزء الغارب ونقطة{mL:5}{mR:f. 92,v.}
lines.plain: *معلوم بقوْس ا ف وقوْس ج ق وذلك أنّ نُقْطة ا حينَئِذٍ تكون على سَمْت الجزء الغارب ونقطة

lines.text: {ov:ب} سَمْت الجزء الطالع من
lines.plain: ب سَمْت الجزء الطالع من

lines.text: دائرة الأُفْق فيكون خطّ
lines.plain: دائرة الأُفْق فيكون خطّ

lines.text: {ov:ب د} خطّ نِصْف فَلَك
lines.plain: ب د خطّ نِصْف فَلَك

lines.text: البروج وبهذا الرَّسْم تعلَم
lines.plain: البروج وبهذا الرَّسْم تعلَم

lines.text: شَكْل ضَوْء الهلال في{mL:10}
lines.plain: شَكْل ضَوْء الهلال في

lines.text: جميع اوقات الشَّهْر بحَسَب
lines.plain: جميع اوقات الشَّهْر بحَسَب

lines.text: بُعْده عن الشمس ومقدار
lines.plain: بُعْده عن الشمس ومقدار

lines.text: ما يقَع له من العرض
lines.plain: ما يقَع له من العرض

lines.text: وكلَّما كان القمر في بُعْده
lines.plain: وكلَّما كان القمر في بُعْده

lines.text: الاقرب كان أَحَدَّ الطَّرفَيْن{mL:15}
lines.plain: الاقرب كان أَحَدَّ الطَّرفَيْن

lines.text: لعِظْم دائرته اكثرَ من الشمس. وذلك ما أَرَدْنا أن نُبَيّن إِن شاء اللّٰه.{n:1}
lines.plain: لعِظْم دائرته اكثرَ من الشمس. وذلك ما أَرَدْنا أن نُبَيّن إِن شاء اللّٰه.

lines.text: فإِذا اردتَّ أن تعرِف مَوْضِع الهلال الذي يُرَى فيه من الفَلَك بحَسَب ارتفاعه عن أُفْق المغرِب
lines.plain: فإِذا اردتَّ أن تعرِف مَوْضِع الهلال الذي يُرَى فيه من الفَلَك بحَسَب ارتفاعه عن أُفْق المغرِب

lines.text: في اوائل الشهور وسمت موضعه الذي يُرَى فيه من دائرة الارتفاع التي تجوز على سَمْت الرُّؤُس وعلى
lines.plain: في اوائل الشهور وسمت موضعه الذي يُرَى فيه من دائرة الارتفاع التي تجوز على سَمْت الرُّؤُس وعلى

lines.text: القمر والافْق بإِشارة يخرُج خطّ البَصَر مع سَمْتها *الى مَوْضِع الهِلال فزِدْ على الجُزْء الذي يتوسَّط{mR:f. 93,r.}
lines.plain: القمر والافْق بإِشارة يخرُج خطّ البَصَر مع سَمْتها *الى مَوْضِع الهِلال فزِدْ على الجُزْء الذي يتوسَّط

lines.text: السماءَ مع القمر قَدْرَ اربع دقائق ليكون ذلك هو الجزء الذي يتوسَّط السماءَ معه في وَقْت الرُّؤْية{mL:20}
lines.plain: السماءَ مع القمر قَدْرَ اربع دقائق ليكون ذلك هو الجزء الذي يتوسَّط السماءَ معه في وَقْت الرُّؤْية

lines.text: وذلك أنّ شُعَاع الشمس يمنَع من رؤْيته مع مَغِيب الشمس حتَّى تنْحَطّ عن الأُفْق مِقْدَارَ ثُمْن ساعة
lines.plain: وذلك أنّ شُعَاع الشمس يمنَع من رؤْيته مع مَغِيب الشمس حتَّى تنْحَطّ عن الأُفْق مِقْدَارَ ثُمْن ساعة

lines.text: بالتقريب ثمّ اعرِفِ ارتفاع القمر المَرْئِيّ بَعْدَ مَغِيب الشمس بثُمْن ساعة معْتَدِلة بالتقريب واعرِفْ
lines.plain: بالتقريب ثمّ اعرِفِ ارتفاع القمر المَرْئِيّ بَعْدَ مَغِيب الشمس بثُمْن ساعة معْتَدِلة بالتقريب واعرِفْ

notes.text: 1) In codice figura, ut semper fieri solet, neglegenter descripta est; arcus quadrantis ج ب in
gradus dividitur, qua re sub schemate legitur وعلى مثل هذا الربع تنقسم الدائرة كلّها ان شاء اللّه.

observations: L05, L07, L08, L09, L13, L14, L19, L20, L21, L22: long joins (ونقطـة at the end of L05; خـطّ on L07 and L08; فَلَـك; تعلَـم; مـا, يقَـع and مـن on L13; بُعْـده on L14; الجُـزْء; معـه and الرُّؤْيـة on L20; ساعـة on L21 and L22; بَعْـدَ) are not transcribed; nor the long kāf of شَكْل (L10).

The page continues chapter 41 and holds its figure. L01 to L05 run the full measure (77 to 501 pt). The figure (F01) stands at the left of the page beside L06 to L15, ten short lines that begin at 390 to 392 pt. L16 begins at 198 pt, under the figure, and ends the construction with a full stop and the reference to the note. L17 begins a new paragraph and is set in by 23 pt (it ends at 477 pt); L18 to L22 run the full measure. Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the left margin beside L05, L10, L15 and L20. Two folio numbers stand in the right margin: «f. 92,v.» beside L05, where the asterisk stands before معلوم at the head of the line, and «f. 93,r.» beside L19, where the asterisk stands between سَمْتها and الى. The one note fills two lines under a rule of 99 pt: the first is set in (104 to 500 pt), its baseline 21 pt under the rule; the second begins at the left edge (77 to 441 pt).

The automatic geometry took the labels of the figure for parts of the lines beside it and found a false line between L02 and L03: the 22 lines are measured from their ink (scratch geom1016.py), the two note lines likewise; the rule and the margin items are those of the automatic geometry.

The figure (F01) is redrawn: the circle of the sun about ه with its upright diameter from ا (at the top, under the word «الجنوب») to ج (at the foot, over the word «الشمال») and its level diameter from ب (at the left, beside the word «المشرق») to د (at the right, beside the word «المغرب»); the level line from ط on that circle through ك to ل at the far left; the upright chord from م to س; the circle of the moon about ز, where the chord cuts the line ط ك; the line from ف to ق, the two points where the circles cut each other; and the line through ز and ه, from the moon's circle at the lower left to ع on the sun's circle, which cuts the moon's circle at ح. The two circles (radii 76.7 and 76.9 pt) and the six lines are least-squares fits to their ink at 600 dpi (tools_s10/fig_measure.py with scratch fig/spec1016.json); each line is drawn between its meetings with the fitted circles, the line to ل to the end of its ink; the nineteen letters and words are set at the centres of their printed ink. In the print the four words stand in the type of the text, the letters ف ع ح د ه ب ز ك ل ق in its large isolated forms, and the letters ا, س, ج, م and ط in smaller sizes; the sizes of the redrawn letters follow the height and the width of the printed ink. The letter ه of the figure is an open ring (4.4 x 5.3 pt), not the filled oval of the letters in the text.

Letters of the figure in the text, in a smaller type, each group under one bar: L01 {ov:ف} (12.8 pt) and {ov:ق} (13.7 pt), each under its own bar, {ov:ه ز} (13.7 pt: the round ه, a filled oval of 2.9 x 3.4 pt, and a zāy with its dot) and {ov:ع} (13.3 pt); L02 {ov:ع}, whose bar is printed in two pieces (5.4 and 7.9 pt, in both copies), and {ov:ف ق} (18.7 pt); L03 {ov:ز ه ع} (21.5 pt), {ov:ح} (13.2 pt) and {ov:ع ح} (15.5 pt); L04 {ov:ف} (11.3 pt) and {ov:ق} (13.3 pt), each under its own bar; L05 {ov:ا ف} (15.4 pt; the alif stands at the right end of the bar), {ov:ج ق} (15.0 pt) and {ov:ا} (13.2 pt); L06 {ov:ب} (13.2 pt); L08 {ov:ب د} (16.0 pt). The letters of each group are those of the ink under its bar, from right to left (scratch barunder.py and the enlargements of the lines).

Final yā': with its two dots in علامتَيْ, وعلامتَيْ, طَرَفَيِ, التي (L02, L18), في (L03, L10, L14, L18, L20), الذي (L17, L18, L19, L20) and المَرْئِيّ; without dots in الأُولَى (L01, L02), على and وعلى, الى (L01, L19), يُرَى (L17, L18) and حتَّى. The hamza stands over its tooth in الدائرتَيْن, الدائرة (twice on L02; the second a small one of 1.8 x 2.5 pt, in both copies), القائم, حينَئِذٍ, دائرة (L07, L18), دائرته, اوائل, دقائق and المَرْئِيّ, and on the line in الضَّوْء, الضوْء, ضَوْء, الجزء (L05, L06, L20), الجُزْء and شاء. The hamza and its kasra stand under the alif in إِن (two marks: a hamza of 2.5 x 2.9 pt and a kasra of 3.6 x 1.8 pt), فإِذا and بإِشارة. The bare hamza stands over the alif in أنّ (L05, L21) and أن (L16, L17) (2.9 x 2.9 pt; the notched form in both copies).

السماءَ (twice on L20): the hamza on the line with a fatha above it in one cluster (4.0 x 5.0 pt; a stroke over the notched hamza in the second copy), as on pp. 131 and 134. والافْق (L19): no hamza and no damma over the lām-alif, in both copies; a sukun high over the fā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt, its top 15.2 pt over the baseline; a broken ring in the second copy), above its dot; الأُفْق (L07, L21) and أُفْق (L17): the hamza with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6-4.0 x 5.8-6.5 pt) and a round sukun over the fā'.

L01: الأُولَى (L01, L02): over the lām-alif the hamza with a damma above it (one cluster of 3.6 x 6.1 pt on L01; joined to the top of the lām-alif on L02) and a fatha over the lām. ونرسُم (L01, L02): a damma over the sīn. تقاطُع: a damma over the ṭā'. الدائرتَيْن: a thick fatha (3.6 x 2.9 pt) over the two dots of the tā' and a round sukun over the yā'. علامتَيْ (L01) and وعلامتَيْ (L04): a fatha over the tā' and a round sukun over the yā'. ونُخْرِج: a damma over the nūn, a round sukun over the khā' and a kasra under the rā'. ايضًا: the fathatan. خطّ (L01, L03, L04, L07, L08, L19) and فخطّ (L03): a shadda over the ṭā'. ونُنْفِذه: a damma over the first nūn, a round sukun over the second and a kasra under the fā'.

L02: تقَع (L02) and يقَع (L13): a fatha over the two dots of the qāf. نِصْف (L02, L08): a kasra under the nūn and a sukun over the ṣād. قَوْس (L02): a fatha over the qāf, above its two dots, and a round sukun over the wāw; بقوْس and وقوْس (L05): the sukun only, in both copies. حيْثُ: a round sukun over the yā' and a damma over the thā'. يقطَعها: a fatha over the ṭā'.

L03: وَسَط (twice): a fatha over the wāw and a fatha over the sīn (two strokes). تَقْوِيس: a fatha over the tā', a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf and a kasra under the wāw. الهِلال (L03, L19): a kasra under the hā'; الهِلَال (L04): the kasra and a fatha over the lām-alif; الهلال (L10, L17): no signs. ومَوْضِع (L03) and مَوْضِع (L17, L19): a fatha over the mīm, a round sukun over the wāw and a short kasra under the ḍād (2.2-2.5 x 1.4 pt); موضعه (L18): no signs. الضَّوْء (L03): over the ḍād a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks) and a round sukun over the wāw; الضوْء (L04): the sukun only; ضَوْء (L10): a fatha over the ḍād and the sukun.
L04: طَرَفَيِ: a fatha over the ṭā', over the rā' and over the fā', and a kasra under the yā'. ومَيْلهما: a fatha over the mīm and a round sukun over the yā'.

L05: أنّ (L05, L21): a shadda over the nūn. نُقْطة: a damma over the nūn and a round sukun close over the two dots of the qāf; ونقطة: no signs. حينَئِذٍ: a fatha over the nūn, the hamza over its tooth with a kasra under it, and the kasratan under the dhāl (4.0 x 3.6 pt). سَمْت (L05, L06, L18) and سَمْتها (L19): a fatha over the sīn and a round sukun over the mīm; وسمت (L18): no signs.
L08: فَلَك: a fatha over the fā', above its dot, and a short fatha over the lām (2.2 x 1.8 pt); الفَلَك (L17): a fatha over the fā' and a fatha over the lām; فلك (L04): no signs.
L09: الرَّسْم: over the rā' a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks) and a round sukun over the sīn. تعلَم: a fatha over the lām.
L10: شَكْل: a fatha over the shīn, above its three dots, and a round sukun over the long kāf.
L11: الشَّهْر: over the shīn a shadda with a fatha in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the hā'. بحَسَب (L11, L17): a fatha over the ḥā' and a fatha over the sīn.
L12: بُعْده (L12, L14): a damma over the bā' and a round sukun over the ʿayn.
L14: وكلَّما: over the lām a shadda with a fatha in one cluster (4.0 x 4.7 pt).

L15: أَحَدَّ: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 5.0 pt), a fatha over the ḥā' and, over the dāl, a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks). الطَّرفَيْن: a shadda on the top of the stem of the ṭā' with a fatha above it, a fatha over the fā', above its dot, and a round sukun over the yā'; nothing over the rā', in both copies (L04 has طَرَفَيِ with its three fathas).

L16: لعِظْم: a kasra under the ʿayn and a round sukun over the ẓā'. اكثرَ: a fatha over the rā'. The full stop after الشمس. أَرَدْنا: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt), a fatha over the rā' and a round sukun over the dāl. نُبَيّن: a damma over the nūn, a fatha over the bā' and a shadda over the yā'; under the yā' its two dots only: no kasra, in both copies. اللّٰه: the shadda and the upright alif over it; then the full stop and the reference to note 1.
L17: اردتَّ: over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks). تعرِف: a kasra under the rā'. يُرَى (L17, L18): a damma over the yā' and a fatha over the rā'. المغرِب: a kasra under the rā'.
L18: الرُّؤُس: over the rā' a shadda with a damma in one cluster (3.6 x 6.5 pt) and over the wāw the hamza with a damma in one cluster (3.6 x 6.1 pt).

L19: يخرُج: a damma over the rā'. البَصَر: a fatha over the bā' and a fatha over the ṣād. فزِدْ: a kasra under the zāy and a round sukun over the dāl. الجُزْء: a damma high over the ligature of the lām and the jīm (2.5 x 5.0 pt, its top 17.7 pt over the baseline) and a round sukun over the zāy; الجزء elsewhere: no signs. يتوسَّط (L19, L20): over the sīn a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks).

L20: قَدْرَ: a fatha over the qāf, above its two dots, a round sukun over the dāl and a fatha over the rā'. وَقْت: a fatha over the wāw and a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf. الرُّؤْية: over the rā' a shadda with a damma in one cluster (3.2 x 6.5 pt) and over the wāw the hamza with a sukun in one cluster (3.2 x 5.8 pt); رؤْيته (L21): the hamza with the sukun (2.9 x 5.4 pt) and nothing over the rā'.

L21: شُعَاع: a damma over the shīn, above its three dots, and a fatha over the ʿayn. يمنَع: a fatha over the nūn. مَغِيب (L21, L22): a fatha over the mīm and a kasra under the ghayn, below the two dots of the yā'. حتَّى: over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks). تنْحَطّ: a round sukun over the nūn, above its dot, a fatha over the ḥā' and a shadda over the ṭā'; so in both copies. مِقْدَارَ: a kasra under the mīm, a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf, a short fatha over the dāl (2.2 x 1.4 pt) and a fatha over the rā'. ثُمْن (L21) and بثُمْن (L22): a damma over the thā' and a round sukun over the mīm.

L22: ثمّ: a shadda over the mīm. اعرِفِ: a kasra under the rā' and a kasra under the tail of the fā', in both copies; واعرِفْ: a kasra under the rā' and a round sukun over the fā'. المَرْئِيّ: a fatha high over the ligature of the lām and the mīm, a round sukun over the rā', the hamza over its tooth with a kasra under it and a shadda over the yā', whose two dots stand under it. بَعْدَ: a fatha over the bā', a round sukun over the ʿayn and a fatha over the dāl. معْتَدِلة: a round sukun over the ʿayn, a fatha close over the two dots of the tā' and a short kasra under the dāl (2.2 x 1.8 pt), as on p. 130.

Notes: two lines: «1) In codice figura, ut semper fieri solet, neglegenter descripta est; arcus quadrantis ج ب in» and «gradus dividitur, qua re sub schemate legitur وعلى مثل هذا الربع تنقسم الدائرة كلّها ان شاء اللّه.» The Arabic stands in the small type (read at 1100 and 2000 dpi): on the first line the letter ج at the right and the letter ب at its left, each with its dot; on the second line the words of the codex, which begin at the right end of the line before the full stop: كلّها with a shadda over the lām, اللّه with a shadda and no upright alif, الدائرة with the hamza over its tooth, شاء with the hamza on the line, ان without a hamza.

figures.name: F01
figures.note: the figure of chapter 41 for the shape of the new moon: the circle of the sun about ه with its upright diameter from ا (the south, at the top) to ج (the north, at the foot) and its level diameter from ب (the east, at the left) to د (the west, at the right); the level line from ط on that circle through ك to ل at the far left; the upright chord from م to س; the circle of the moon about ز, where the chord م س cuts the line ط ك; the line from ف to ق, the two points where the circles cut each other; and the line through ز and ه, from the moon's circle at the lower left to ع on the sun's circle, which cuts the moon's circle at ح; with the words «الجنوب», «المغرب», «المشرق» and «الشمال» at the top, the right, the left and the foot. Measured with tools_s10/fig_measure.py at 600 dpi (scratch fig/spec1016.json): the two circles and the six lines are least-squares fits to their ink (stroke centres and widths); each line is drawn between its meetings with the fitted circles (the line to ل to the end of its ink); the nineteen letters and words are set at the centres of their printed ink. The letters stand in types of different sizes in the print: the words in the type of the text (13.8 pt here, narrowed to their printed width), the letters ف ع ح د ه ب ز ك ل ق in its large isolated forms (15.5 pt here, as in the other figures), and ا, س, ج, م and ط smaller (13, 13.5, 10.5, 9.5 and 9.5 pt here, from the height and the width of their printed ink)
